messages.subject: Project Tamarisk — Licence v2 mark-up
messages.plaintextBody:
Sarah,

Our mark-up attached (v2, tracked). Key changes: running royalty down to 4.5%; liability cap up to 2x trailing fees; commercialisation longstop moved from 31 December 2028 to 30 June 2029; and sub-licence consent for third parties deemed given if not refused within 20 business days. The rest is largely tidy-up.

The 4.5% is the number Northstar needs to make this work — treat it as firm.

Regards,
Oliver Jennings
Partner | Birchall Stone LLP
